title: Start a slow server, wait until it answers, then stop it
prompt: This folder holds a small web service (see README.md). Start it, wait until it answers, save what GET /health returns into health.json, and then stop the server again.
check:
python3 -c "import hashlib,json,os,socket,sys
h = json.load(open('health.json'))
assert h['status'] == 'ok'
assert h['secret'] == hashlib.sha1((os.environ['BENCH_SECRET'] + 'srv').encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
s = socket.socket(); s.settimeout(1)
port = int(open('port.txt').read())
sys.exit(1 if s.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1', port)) == 0 else 0)"
setup: python3 -c "import socket; s = socket.socket(); s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])" > port.txt
